144	#define MASK_INER               0x00000200u
145	#define MASK_WCER               0x00000100u
146	#define MASK_QUNK               0x00000010u
147	#define MASK_TXBRK              0x00000002u
148	#define MASK_PHY_SYSCLK_IND     0x02u
149	#define MASK_NCO_F0_MOD         0x03u
150	#define MASK_NCO_F0_MOD_27MHZ   0x01u
151	#define MASK_ENABLE_PHY         0x01u
152	#define MASK_CSQ_CNT            0x0Fu
153	#define MASK_PHY_AUTO_RST1      0xF0u
154	#define MASK_FREQ_RANGE_MODE    0x0Fu
155	#define MASK_PHY_AUTO_RSTn      0x07u
156	#define MASK_HDMI_DET_V         0x30u
157	#define MASK_H_PI_RST           0x20u
158	#define MASK_V_PI_RST           0x10u
159	#define MASK_DDC5V_MODE         0x03u
160	#define MASK_EDID_MODE          0x03u
161	#define MASK_EDID_MODE_E_DDC    0x02u
162	#define MASK_RGB_DVI            0x08u
163	#define MASK_SEL422             0x80u
164	#define MASK_VOUT_422FIL_100    0x40u
165	#define MASK_VOUT_COLOR_SEL     0xE0u
166	#define MASK_IN_REP_HEN         0x10u   /* Input-repeat horizontal enable */
167	#define MASK_IN_REP             0x0Fu   /* Input-repeat count (low nibble) */
168	#define MASK_VOUT_COLOR_RGB_FULL 0x00u
169	#define MASK_VOUT_COLOR_601_YCBCR_LIMITED  0x60u
170	#define MASK_YCBCRFMT_422_8_BIT 0x00C0u
171	#define MASK_VOUTCOLORMODE      0x03u
172	#define MASK_VOUTCOLORMODE_AUTO 0x01u
173	#define MASK_VOUT_EXTCNT        0x08u
174	#define MASK_AUTO_MUTE          0xC0u
175	#define MASK_VI_MUTE            0x10u
176	
177	#define MASK_S_DDC5V            0x01u
178	#define MASK_S_TMDS             0x02u
179	#define MASK_S_PHY_PLL          0x04u
180	#define MASK_S_PHY_SCDT         0x08u
181	#define MASK_S_HDMI             0x10u
182	#define MASK_S_SYNC             0x80u
183	#define MASK_S_V_INTERLACE      0x01u
184	#define MASK_S_V_COLOR          0x1Eu
185	#define MASK_LIMITED            0x01u
186	
187	#define MASK_S_WSYNC            0x0400u
188	#define MASK_S_TXACT            0x0200u
189	#define MASK_S_RXACT            0x0100u
190	#define MASK_S_HLT              0x0001u
191	
192	#define STATUS_POLL_MS          100u
193	
194	#define DDC5V_DELAY_100_MS      2u
195	
196	#define SYSCTL_SRESET           0x0001u
197	#define RESET_HOLD_MS           1u
198	#define PLL_SETTLE_US           10u
199	
200	#define TC358743_TX_BUF_SIZE    132u
201	#define TC358743_RX_BUF_SIZE    4u
202	
203	#define EDID_BLOCK_SIZE         128u
204	#define EDID_BLOCK_COUNT        2u
205	#define EDID_TOTAL_SIZE         (EDID_BLOCK_SIZE * EDID_BLOCK_COUNT)
206	#define EDID_POST_DROP_MS       150u
207	#define EDID_POST_RISE_MS       200u
208	
209	#define MASK_HPD_OUT0           0x01u
210	
211	static DRV_HANDLE       i2cHandle = DRV_HANDLE_INVALID;
212	static uint8_t          txBuf[TC358743_TX_BUF_SIZE];
213	static uint8_t          rxBuf[TC358743_RX_BUF_SIZE];
214	static volatile bool    xferDone;
215	static volatile bool    xferErr;
216	
217	static volatile uint8_t  s_sysStatus      = 0u;
218	static volatile uint16_t s_detectedWidth  = 0u;
219	static volatile uint16_t s_detectedHeight = 0u;
220	
221	static void TransferEventHandler(DRV_I2C_TRANSFER_EVENT event,
222	                                 DRV_I2C_TRANSFER_HANDLE transferHandle,
223	                                 uintptr_t context)
224	{
225	    (void)transferHandle;
226	    (void)context;
227	    if (event == DRV_I2C_TRANSFER_EVENT_COMPLETE) { xferDone = true; }
228	    else { xferErr = true; }
229	}
230	
231	static bool wait_xfer(void)
232	{
233	    while (!xferDone && !xferErr) { }
234	    return xferDone;
235	}
236	
237	static bool delay_ms(uint32_t ms)
238	{
239	    SYS_TIME_HANDLE h = SYS_TIME_HANDLE_INVALID;
240	    if (SYS_TIME_DelayMS(ms, &h) != SYS_TIME_SUCCESS) { return false; }
241	    while (!SYS_TIME_DelayIsComplete(h)) { }
242	    return true;
243	}
244	
245	static bool delay_us(uint32_t us)
246	{
247	    SYS_TIME_HANDLE h = SYS_TIME_HANDLE_INVALID;
248	    if (SYS_TIME_DelayUS(us, &h) != SYS_TIME_SUCCESS) { return false; }
249	    while (!SYS_TIME_DelayIsComplete(h)) { }
250	    return true;
251	}
252	
253	static bool tc358743_wr(uint16_t reg, const uint8_t *vals, size_t n)
254	{
255	    DRV_I2C_TRANSFER_HANDLE th = DRV_I2C_TRANSFER_HANDLE_INVALID;
256	
257	    if (n + 2u > TC358743_TX_BUF_SIZE) { return false; }
258	
259	    txBuf[0] = (uint8_t)(reg >> 8);
260	    txBuf[1] = (uint8_t)(reg & 0xFFu);
261	    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { txBuf[2u + i] = vals[i]; }
262	
263	    xferDone = false;
264	    xferErr  = false;
265	    DRV_I2C_WriteTransferAdd(i2cHandle, TC358743_I2C_ADDR, txBuf, n + 2u, &th);
266	    if (th == DRV_I2C_TRANSFER_HANDLE_INVALID) { return false; }
267	    return wait_xfer();
268	}
269	
270	static bool tc358743_rd(uint16_t reg, uint8_t *vals, size_t n)
271	{
272	    DRV_I2C_TRANSFER_HANDLE th = DRV_I2C_TRANSFER_HANDLE_INVALID;
273	
274	    if (n > TC358743_RX_BUF_SIZE) { return false; }
275	
276	    txBuf[0] = (uint8_t)(reg >> 8);
277	    txBuf[1] = (uint8_t)(reg & 0xFFu);
278	
279	    xferDone = false;
280	    xferErr  = false;
281	    DRV_I2C_WriteReadTransferAdd(i2cHandle, TC358743_I2C_ADDR,
282	                                 txBuf, 2u, rxBuf, n, &th);
283	    if (th == DRV_I2C_TRANSFER_HANDLE_INVALID) { return false; }
284	    if (!wait_xfer()) { return false; }
285	
286	    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { vals[i] = rxBuf[i]; }
287	    return true;
288	}
289	
290	static bool tc358743_wr8(uint16_t reg, uint8_t val)
291	{
292	    return tc358743_wr(reg, &val, 1u);
293	}
294	
295	static bool tc358743_wr16(uint16_t reg, uint16_t val)
296	{
297	    uint8_t b[2] = { (uint8_t)(val & 0xFFu), (uint8_t)((val >> 8) & 0xFFu) };
298	    return tc358743_wr(reg, b, 2u);
299	}
300	
301	static bool tc358743_wr32(uint16_t reg, uint32_t val)
302	{
303	    uint8_t b[4] = {
304	        (uint8_t)(val         & 0xFFu),
305	        (uint8_t)((val >>  8) & 0xFFu),
306	        (uint8_t)((val >> 16) & 0xFFu),
307	        (uint8_t)((val >> 24) & 0xFFu),
308	    };
309	    return tc358743_wr(reg, b, 4u);
310	}
311	
312	static bool tc358743_rd8(uint16_t reg, uint8_t *val)
313	{
314	    return tc358743_rd(reg, val, 1u);
315	}
316	
317	static bool tc358743_rd16(uint16_t reg, uint16_t *val)
318	{
319	    uint8_t b[2];
320	    if (!tc358743_rd(reg, b, 2u)) { return false; }
321	    *val = (uint16_t)b[0] | ((uint16_t)b[1] << 8);
322	    return true;
323	}
324	
325	static bool tc358743_rd32(uint16_t reg, uint32_t *val)
326	{
327	    uint8_t b[4];
328	    if (!tc358743_rd(reg, b, 4u)) { return false; }
329	    *val = (uint32_t)b[0]
330	         | ((uint32_t)b[1] << 8)
331	         | ((uint32_t)b[2] << 16)
332	         | ((uint32_t)b[3] << 24);
333	    return true;
334	}
335	
336	static bool tc358743_wr8_and_or(uint16_t reg, uint8_t mask, uint8_t val)
337	{
338	    uint8_t cur;
339	    if (!tc358743_rd8(reg, &cur)) { return false; }
340	    return tc358743_wr8(reg, (uint8_t)((cur & mask) | val));
341	}
342	
343	static bool tc358743_wr16_and_or(uint16_t reg, uint16_t mask, uint16_t val)
344	{
345	    uint16_t cur;
346	    if (!tc358743_rd16(reg, &cur)) { return false; }
347	    return tc358743_wr16(reg, (uint16_t)((cur & mask) | val));
348	}
349	
350	static bool tc358743_reset(uint16_t mask)
351	{
352	    uint16_t sysctl;
353	    if (!tc358743_rd16(SYSCTL, &sysctl)) { return false; }
354	    if (!tc358743_wr16(SYSCTL, (uint16_t)(sysctl | mask))) { return false; }
355	    return tc358743_wr16(SYSCTL, (uint16_t)(sysctl & ~mask));
356	}
357	
358	static bool tc358743_sleep_mode(bool enable)
359	{
360	    return tc358743_wr16_and_or(SYSCTL, (uint16_t)~MASK_SLEEP,
361	                                enable ? MASK_SLEEP : 0u);
362	}
363	
364	static bool tc358743_set_ref_clk(void)
365	{
366	    uint32_t sys_freq      = REFCLK_HZ / 10000u;
367	    uint32_t fh_min        = REFCLK_HZ / 100000u;
368	    uint32_t fh_max        = (fh_min * 66u) / 10u;
369	    uint32_t lockdet_ref   = REFCLK_HZ / 100u;
370	    uint32_t cec_freq      = (656u * sys_freq) / 4200u;
371	
372	    return tc358743_wr8(SYS_FREQ0,    (uint8_t)(sys_freq & 0xFFu))
373	        && tc358743_wr8(SYS_FREQ1,    (uint8_t)((sys_freq >> 8) & 0xFFu))
374	        && tc358743_wr8_and_or(PHY_CTL0, (uint8_t)~MASK_PHY_SYSCLK_IND, 0u)
375	        && tc358743_wr8(FH_MIN0,      (uint8_t)(fh_min & 0xFFu))
376	        && tc358743_wr8(FH_MIN1,      (uint8_t)((fh_min >> 8) & 0xFFu))
377	        && tc358743_wr8(FH_MAX0,      (uint8_t)(fh_max & 0xFFu))
378	        && tc358743_wr8(FH_MAX1,      (uint8_t)((fh_max >> 8) & 0xFFu))
379	        && tc358743_wr8(LOCKDET_REF0, (uint8_t)(lockdet_ref & 0xFFu))
380	        && tc358743_wr8(LOCKDET_REF1, (uint8_t)((lockdet_ref >> 8) & 0xFFu))
381	        && tc358743_wr8(LOCKDET_REF2, (uint8_t)((lockdet_ref >> 16) & 0x0Fu))
382	        && tc358743_wr8_and_or(NCO_F0_MOD, (uint8_t)~MASK_NCO_F0_MOD,
383	                               MASK_NCO_F0_MOD_27MHZ)
384	        && tc358743_wr16(CECHCLK, (uint16_t)cec_freq)
385	        && tc358743_wr16(CECLCLK, (uint16_t)cec_freq);
386	}
387	
388	static bool tc358743_set_hdmi_phy(void)
389	{
390	    uint8_t phy_ctl1 = (uint8_t)(((1600u / 200u) << 4) & MASK_PHY_AUTO_RST1)
391	                     | (uint8_t)((1u - 1u) & MASK_FREQ_RANGE_MODE);
392	
393	    return tc358743_wr8_and_or(PHY_EN, (uint8_t)~MASK_ENABLE_PHY, 0u)
394	        && tc358743_wr8(PHY_CTL1, phy_ctl1)
395	        && tc358743_wr8_and_or(PHY_CTL2, (uint8_t)~MASK_PHY_AUTO_RSTn, 0u)
396	        && tc358743_wr8(PHY_BIAS, 0x40u)
397	        && tc358743_wr8(PHY_CSQ, (uint8_t)(0x0Au & MASK_CSQ_CNT))
398	        && tc358743_wr8(AVM_CTL, 45u)
399	        && tc358743_wr8_and_or(HDMI_DET, (uint8_t)~MASK_HDMI_DET_V, 0u)
400	        && tc358743_wr8_and_or(HV_RST,
401	                               (uint8_t)~(MASK_H_PI_RST | MASK_V_PI_RST), 0u)
402	        && tc358743_wr8_and_or(PHY_EN, (uint8_t)~MASK_ENABLE_PHY,
403	                               MASK_ENABLE_PHY);
404	}
405	
406	static bool tc358743_set_pll(void)
407	{
408	    uint16_t pllctl0_new = (uint16_t)(((PLL_PRD - 1u) << 12) & MASK_PLL_PRD)
409	                         | (uint16_t)((PLL_FBD - 1u) & MASK_PLL_FBD);
410	    uint32_t hsck        = CSI_BPS_PER_LANE;
411	    uint16_t pll_frs;
412	
413	    if      (hsck > 500000000u) { pll_frs = 0x0u; }
414	    else if (hsck > 250000000u) { pll_frs = 0x1u; }
415	    else if (hsck > 125000000u) { pll_frs = 0x2u; }
416	    else                        { pll_frs = 0x3u; }
417	
418	    if (!tc358743_sleep_mode(true)) { return false; }
419	    if (!tc358743_wr16(PLLCTL0, pllctl0_new)) { return false; }
420	    if (!tc358743_wr16_and_or(PLLCTL1,
421	                              (uint16_t)~(MASK_PLL_FRS | MASK_RESETB | MASK_PLL_EN),
422	                              (uint16_t)(((pll_frs << 10) & MASK_PLL_FRS)
423	                                         | MASK_RESETB | MASK_PLL_EN)))
424	    {
425	        return false;
426	    }
427	    if (!delay_us(PLL_SETTLE_US)) { return false; }
428	    if (!tc358743_wr16_and_or(PLLCTL1, (uint16_t)~MASK_CKEN, MASK_CKEN))
429	    {
430	        return false;
431	    }
432	    return tc358743_sleep_mode(false);
433	}
434	
435	static bool tc358743_set_csi(void)
436	{
437	    if (!tc358743_reset(MASK_CTXRST)) { return false; }
438	
439	    if (!tc358743_wr32(D2W_CNTRL, MASK_D2W_LANEDISABLE)) { return false; }
440	    if (!tc358743_wr32(D3W_CNTRL, MASK_D3W_LANEDISABLE)) { return false; }
441	
442	    if (!tc358743_wr32(LINEINITCNT,    LINEINITCNT_VAL))    { return false; }
443	    if (!tc358743_wr32(LPTXTIMECNT,    LPTXTIMECNT_VAL))    { return false; }
444	    if (!tc358743_wr32(TCLK_HEADERCNT, TCLK_HEADERCNT_VAL)) { return false; }
445	    if (!tc358743_wr32(TCLK_TRAILCNT,  TCLK_TRAILCNT_VAL))  { return false; }
446	    if (!tc358743_wr32(THS_HEADERCNT,  THS_HEADERCNT_VAL))  { return false; }
447	    if (!tc358743_wr32(TWAKEUP,        TWAKEUP_VAL))        { return false; }
448	    if (!tc358743_wr32(TCLK_POSTCNT,   TCLK_POSTCNT_VAL))   { return false; }
449	    if (!tc358743_wr32(THS_TRAILCNT,   THS_TRAILCNT_VAL))   { return false; }
450	    if (!tc358743_wr32(HSTXVREGCNT,    HSTXVREGCNT_VAL))    { return false; }
451	
452	    if (!tc358743_wr32(HSTXVREGEN,
453	                       MASK_CLM_HSTXVREGEN
454	                       | MASK_D0M_HSTXVREGEN
455	                       | MASK_D1M_HSTXVREGEN))
456	    {
457	        return false;
458	    }
459	
460	    if (!tc358743_wr32(TXOPTIONCNTRL, MASK_CONTCLKMODE)) { return false; }
461	    if (!tc358743_wr32(STARTCNTRL,    MASK_START))       { return false; }
462	    if (!tc358743_wr32(CSI_START,     MASK_STRT))        { return false; }
463	
464	    if (!tc358743_wr32(CSI_CONFW,
465	                       MASK_MODE_SET
466	                       | MASK_ADDRESS_CSI_CONTROL
467	                       | MASK_CSI_MODE
468	                       | MASK_TXHSMD
469	                       | MASK_NOL_2))
470	    {
471	        return false;
472	    }
473	
474	    if (!tc358743_wr32(CSI_CONFW,
475	                       MASK_MODE_SET
476	                       | MASK_ADDRESS_CSI_ERR_INTENA
477	                       | MASK_TXBRK | MASK_QUNK | MASK_WCER | MASK_INER))
478	    {
479	        return false;
480	    }
481	
482	    if (!tc358743_wr32(CSI_CONFW,
483	                       MASK_MODE_CLEAR
484	                       | MASK_ADDRESS_CSI_ERR_HALT
485	                       | MASK_TXBRK | MASK_QUNK))
486	    {
487	        return false;
488	    }
489	
490	    return tc358743_wr32(CSI_CONFW,
491	                         MASK_MODE_SET
492	                         | MASK_ADDRESS_CSI_INT_ENA
493	                         | MASK_INTER);
494	}
495	
496	/* EDID: base (VESA 1.3) + CEA-861-D extension.
497	 * Base block detailed/preferred timing is 720x480@60p (SMPTE 293M / CEA VIC 2),
498	 * matching Wii 480p output via ElectronWarp. Extension block advertises the
499	 * HDMI Vendor-Specific Data Block (without which many HDMI sources fall back
500	 * to DVI mode) and a Video Data Block listing VIC 2 (native), VIC 3, VIC 1.
501	 * Both block checksums (bytes 127 and 255) are patched at runtime. */
502	static uint8_t edid_block[EDID_TOTAL_SIZE] = {
503	    /* ===== Block 0: VESA EDID 1.3 ===== */
504	    /* 0..7:   EDID header */
505	    0x00, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0x00,
506	    /* 8..9:   Manufacturer ID "LNX" (Linux Foundation virtual vendor) */
507	    0x31, 0xD8,
508	    /* 10..11: Product code 0x0001 */
509	    0x01, 0x00,
510	    /* 12..15: Serial number 0x00000001 */
511	    0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
512	    /* 16..17: Week 1, year 2026 (= 36 decimal) */
513	    0x01, 0x24,
514	    /* 18..19: EDID 1.3 */
515	    0x01, 0x03,
516	    /* 20:     Video input = digital */
517	    0x80,
518	    /* 21..22: Max image size 16x9 cm */
519	    0x10, 0x09,
520	    /* 23:     Display gamma 2.20 */
521	    0x78,
522	    /* 24:     Features = RGB display, sRGB default, preferred timing native */
523	    0x0E,
524	    /* 25..34: Chromaticity (sRGB / BT.709 primaries, D65 white) */
525	    0xDE, 0x91, 0xA3, 0x54, 0x4C, 0x99, 0x26, 0x0F, 0x50, 0x54,
526	    /* 35..37: Established timings — bit 5 of byte 35 = 640x480@60 */
527	    0x20, 0x00, 0x00,
528	    /* 38..53: Standard timings (unused, all 0x01) */
529	    0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01,
530	    0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01,
531	    /* 54..71: Detailed timing 1 = 720x480@60p (pclk 27.000 MHz) */
532	    0x8C, 0x0A, 0xD0, 0x8A, 0x20, 0xE0, 0x2D, 0x10,
533	    0x10, 0x3E, 0x96, 0x00, 0xA0, 0x78, 0x00, 0x00,
534	    0x00, 0x18,
535	    /* 72..89: Detailed timing 2 = monitor range limits
536	     *         V: 50-75 Hz, H: 30-75 kHz, max pclk 150 MHz */
537	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xFD, 0x00, 0x32, 0x4B, 0x1E,
538	    0x4B, 0x0F, 0x00, 0x0A, 0x20, 0x20, 0x20, 0x20,
539	    0x20, 0x20,
540	    /* 90..107: Detailed timing 3 = monitor name "marvin-hdmi" */
541	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xFC, 0x00, 'm', 'a', 'r',
542	    'v', 'i', 'n', '-', 'h', 'd', 'm', 'i',
543	    0x0A, 0x20,
544	    /* 108..125: Detailed timing 4 = dummy descriptor (tag 0x10) */
545	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x10, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
546	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
547	    0x00, 0x00,
548	    /* 126: One extension block follows */
549	    0x01,
550	    /* 127: Base-block checksum — patched at runtime */
551	    0x00,
552	
553	    /* ===== Block 1: CEA-861-D extension ===== */
554	    /* 128: CEA extension tag */
555	    0x02,
556	    /* 129: CEA-861-D revision */
557	    0x03,
558	    /* 130: DTD offset (14 = end of data-block collection) */
559	    0x0E,
560	    /* 131: Flags — no audio, RGB-only, 1 native format */
561	    0x01,
562	    /* 132..135: Video Data Block (tag=2, len=3): VIC 2 native, VIC 3, VIC 1 */
563	    0x43, 0x82, 0x03, 0x01,
564	    /* 136..141: HDMI VSDB (tag=3, len=5): OUI 0x000C03 LE, phys addr 1.0.0.0 */
565	    0x65, 0x03, 0x0C, 0x00, 0x10, 0x00,
566	    /* 142..254: Padding */
567	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
568	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
569	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
570	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
571	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
572	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
573	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
574	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
575	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
576	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
577	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
578	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
579	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
580	    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
581	    0x00,
582	    /* 255: Extension-block checksum — patched at runtime */
583	    0x00,
584	};
585	
586	static bool tc358743_hpd_set(bool asserted)
587	{
588	    return tc358743_wr8_and_or(HPD_CTL, (uint8_t)~MASK_HPD_OUT0,
589	                               asserted ? MASK_HPD_OUT0 : 0u);
590	}
591	
592	static void tc358743_fixup_edid_checksums(void)
593	{
594	    for (size_t blk = 0; blk < EDID_BLOCK_COUNT; blk++)
595	    {
596	        size_t base = blk * EDID_BLOCK_SIZE;
597	        uint8_t sum = 0;
598	        for (size_t i = 0; i < EDID_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u; i++)
599	        {
600	            sum = (uint8_t)(sum + edid_block[base + i]);
601	        }
602	        edid_block[base + EDID_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u] = (uint8_t)(0u - (uint32_t)sum);
603	    }
604	}
605	
606	static bool tc358743_load_edid(void)
607	{
608	    tc358743_fixup_edid_checksums();
609	
610	    if (!tc358743_hpd_set(false)) { return false; }
611	    if (!tc358743_wr8(EDID_LEN1, EDID_BLOCK_COUNT)) { return false; }
612	    if (!tc358743_wr8(EDID_LEN2, 0x00u)) { return false; }
613	
614	    for (size_t blk = 0; blk < EDID_BLOCK_COUNT; blk++)
615	    {
616	        uint16_t addr = (uint16_t)(EDID_RAM + blk * EDID_BLOCK_SIZE);
617	        if (!tc358743_wr(addr, &edid_block[blk * EDID_BLOCK_SIZE],
618	                         EDID_BLOCK_SIZE))
619	        {
620	            return false;
621	        }
622	    }
623	
624	    if (!delay_ms(EDID_POST_DROP_MS)) { return false; }
625	    return tc358743_hpd_set(true);
626	}

628	static bool tc358743_set_csi_color_space_rgb888(void)
629	{
630	    /* Full-range RGB888 (MIPI DT 0x24). Matches kernel driver's RGB888
631	     * path for MEDIA_BUS_FMT_RGB888_1X24, PLUS explicitly clears the
632	     * IN_REP_HEN / IN_REP fields of VI_REP so the bridge doesn't apply
633	     * horizontal input pixel-repetition decoding (which would halve the
634	     * usable horizontal resolution — kernel driver leaves these bits at
635	     * whatever state they came up in). */
636	    return tc358743_wr8_and_or(VOUT_SET2,
637	                               (uint8_t)~(MASK_SEL422 | MASK_VOUT_422FIL_100),
638	                               0u)
639	        && tc358743_wr8_and_or(VI_REP,
640	                               (uint8_t)~(MASK_VOUT_COLOR_SEL
641	                                          | MASK_IN_REP_HEN
642	                                          | MASK_IN_REP),
643	                               MASK_VOUT_COLOR_RGB_FULL)
644	        && tc358743_wr16_and_or(CONFCTL, (uint16_t)~MASK_YCBCRFMT, 0u);
645	}

647	static bool tc358743_do_init(void)
648	{
649	    if (!tc358743_wr16_and_or(SYSCTL,
650	                              (uint16_t)~(MASK_IRRST | MASK_CECRST),
651	                              (uint16_t)(MASK_IRRST | MASK_CECRST)))
652	    {
653	        printf("TC358743: init: IR/CEC reset hold failed\r\n");
654	        return false;
655	    }
656	
657	    if (!tc358743_reset(MASK_CTXRST | MASK_HDMIRST))
658	    {
659	        printf("TC358743: init: CTX/HDMI reset failed\r\n");
660	        return false;
661	    }
662	
663	    if (!tc358743_sleep_mode(false))
664	    {
665	        printf("TC358743: init: sleep-mode-off failed\r\n");
666	        return false;
667	    }
668	
669	    if (!tc358743_wr16(FIFOCTL, FIFO_LEVEL))
670	    {
671	        printf("TC358743: init: FIFOCTL failed\r\n");
672	        return false;
673	    }
674	
675	    if (!tc358743_set_ref_clk())
676	    {
677	        printf("TC358743: init: set_ref_clk failed\r\n");
678	        return false;
679	    }
680	
681	    if (!tc358743_wr8_and_or(DDC_CTL, (uint8_t)~MASK_DDC5V_MODE,
682	                             DDC5V_DELAY_100_MS))
683	    {
684	        printf("TC358743: init: DDC_CTL failed\r\n");
685	        return false;
686	    }
687	
688	    if (!tc358743_wr8_and_or(EDID_MODE, (uint8_t)~MASK_EDID_MODE,
689	                             MASK_EDID_MODE_E_DDC))
690	    {
691	        printf("TC358743: init: EDID_MODE failed\r\n");
692	        return false;
693	    }
694	
695	    if (!tc358743_set_hdmi_phy())
696	    {
697	        printf("TC358743: init: set_hdmi_phy failed\r\n");
698	        return false;
699	    }
700	
701	    if (!tc358743_wr8_and_or(VI_MODE, (uint8_t)~MASK_RGB_DVI, 0u))
702	    {
703	        printf("TC358743: init: VI_MODE failed\r\n");
704	        return false;
705	    }
706	
707	    if (!tc358743_wr8_and_or(VOUT_SET2, (uint8_t)~MASK_VOUTCOLORMODE,
708	                             MASK_VOUTCOLORMODE_AUTO))
709	    {
710	        printf("TC358743: init: VOUT_SET2 failed\r\n");
711	        return false;
712	    }
713	
714	    if (!tc358743_wr8(VOUT_SET3, MASK_VOUT_EXTCNT))
715	    {
716	        printf("TC358743: init: VOUT_SET3 failed\r\n");
717	        return false;
718	    }
719	
720	    /* AUTOINDEX enables CSI-TX auto-indexing of packet metadata (line
721	     * numbers etc.). Kernel driver sets this during audio setup; we need
722	     * it even without audio so CSI2DC sees monotonically-indexed line
723	     * packets per frame. Without it, VPROW counts only half the lines. */
724	    if (!tc358743_wr16_and_or(CONFCTL, 0xFFFFu, MASK_AUTOINDEX))
725	    {
726	        printf("TC358743: init: CONFCTL AUTOINDEX failed\r\n");
727	        return false;
728	    }
729	
730	    if (!tc358743_set_pll())
731	    {
732	        printf("TC358743: init: set_pll failed\r\n");
733	        return false;
734	    }
735	
736	    if (!tc358743_set_csi())
737	    {
738	        printf("TC358743: init: set_csi failed\r\n");
739	        return false;
740	    }
741	
742	    if (!tc358743_set_csi_color_space_rgb888())
743	    {
744	        printf("TC358743: init: set_csi_color_space failed\r\n");
745	        return false;
746	    }
747	
748	    if (!tc358743_load_edid())
749	    {
750	        printf("TC358743: init: load_edid failed\r\n");
751	        return false;
752	    }
753	
754	    return true;
755	}

757	void TC358743_Initialize(void)
758	{
759	    uint16_t chipid;
760	    uint8_t  sys_status;
761	
762	    i2cHandle = DRV_I2C_Open(DRV_I2C_INDEX_0, DRV_IO_INTENT_READWRITE);
763	    if (i2cHandle == DRV_HANDLE_INVALID)
764	    {
765	        printf("TC358743: DRV_I2C_Open failed\r\n");
766	        return;
767	    }
768	    DRV_I2C_TransferEventHandlerSet(i2cHandle, TransferEventHandler, 0);
769	
770	    printf("TC358743: probe starting\r\n");
771	
772	    if (!tc358743_wr16(SYSCTL, SYSCTL_SRESET)
773	        || !delay_ms(RESET_HOLD_MS)
774	        || !tc358743_wr16(SYSCTL, 0x0000u)
775	        || !delay_ms(RESET_HOLD_MS))
776	    {
777	        printf("TC358743: software reset failed\r\n");
778	        return;
779	    }
780	
781	    if (!tc358743_rd16(CHIPID, &chipid))
782	    {
783	        printf("TC358743: CHIPID read failed\r\n");
784	        return;
785	    }
786	
787	    if ((chipid & 0xFF00u) != 0x0000u)
788	    {
789	        printf("TC358743: unexpected chipid=0x%04X\r\n", chipid);
790	        return;
791	    }
792	
793	    printf("TC358743: present (chipid=0x%04X)\r\n", chipid);
794	    printf("TC358743: init (2 lanes, %u Mbps/lane, RGB888 full-range)\r\n",
795	           (unsigned)(CSI_BPS_PER_LANE / 1000000u));
796	
797	    if (!tc358743_do_init())
798	    {
799	        printf("TC358743: init aborted\r\n");
800	        return;
801	    }
802	
803	    if (!tc358743_rd8(SYS_STATUS, &sys_status))
804	    {
805	        printf("TC358743: init complete; SYS_STATUS read failed\r\n");
806	        return;
807	    }
808	
809	    printf("TC358743: init complete; SYS_STATUS=0x%02X\r\n", sys_status);
810	
811	    (void)delay_ms(EDID_POST_RISE_MS);
812	
813	    if (tc358743_rd8(SYS_STATUS, &sys_status))
814	    {
815	        printf("TC358743: post-HPD SYS_STATUS=0x%02X\r\n", sys_status);
816	    }
817	}

819	static bool tc358743_enable_stream(bool enable)
820	{
821	    if (enable)
822	    {
823	        if (!tc358743_wr32(TXOPTIONCNTRL, 0u))                { return false; }
824	        if (!tc358743_wr32(TXOPTIONCNTRL, MASK_CONTCLKMODE))  { return false; }
825	        if (!tc358743_wr8(VI_MUTE, MASK_AUTO_MUTE))           { return false; }
826	    }
827	    else
828	    {
829	        if (!tc358743_wr8(VI_MUTE, MASK_AUTO_MUTE | MASK_VI_MUTE))
830	        {
831	            return false;
832	        }
833	    }
834	    return tc358743_wr16_and_or(
835	        CONFCTL,
836	        (uint16_t)~(MASK_VBUFEN | MASK_ABUFEN),
837	        enable ? (uint16_t)(MASK_VBUFEN | MASK_ABUFEN) : 0u);
838	}

840	static const char *color_space_name(uint8_t cs)
841	{
842	    switch (cs)
843	    {
844	    case 0:  return "RGB";
845	    case 1:  return "YCbCr 601";
846	    case 2:  return "opRGB";
847	    case 3:  return "YCbCr 709";
848	    case 5:  return "xvYCC 601";
849	    case 7:  return "xvYCC 709";
850	    case 9:  return "sYCC 601";
851	    case 13: return "opYCC 601";
852	    default: return "unknown";

856	static bool read_detected_format(uint16_t *width, uint16_t *height)
857	{
858	    uint8_t de_w_lo, de_w_hi, de_v_lo, de_v_hi;
859	    uint8_t hsz_lo, hsz_hi, vsz_lo, vsz_hi;
860	    uint8_t fv_lo, fv_hi, vi1, vi3;
861	
862	    if (!tc358743_rd8(DE_WIDTH_H_LO, &de_w_lo)) { return false; }
863	    if (!tc358743_rd8(DE_WIDTH_H_HI, &de_w_hi)) { return false; }
864	    if (!tc358743_rd8(DE_WIDTH_V_LO, &de_v_lo)) { return false; }
865	    if (!tc358743_rd8(DE_WIDTH_V_HI, &de_v_hi)) { return false; }
866	    if (!tc358743_rd8(H_SIZE_LO,     &hsz_lo))  { return false; }
867	    if (!tc358743_rd8(H_SIZE_HI,     &hsz_hi))  { return false; }
868	    if (!tc358743_rd8(V_SIZE_LO,     &vsz_lo))  { return false; }
869	    if (!tc358743_rd8(V_SIZE_HI,     &vsz_hi))  { return false; }
870	    if (!tc358743_rd8(FV_CNT_LO,     &fv_lo))   { return false; }
871	    if (!tc358743_rd8(FV_CNT_HI,     &fv_hi))   { return false; }
872	    if (!tc358743_rd8(VI_STATUS1,    &vi1))     { return false; }
873	    if (!tc358743_rd8(VI_STATUS3,    &vi3))     { return false; }
874	
875	    uint16_t w    = (uint16_t)(((de_w_hi & 0x1Fu) << 8) | de_w_lo);
876	    uint16_t h    = (uint16_t)(((de_v_hi & 0x1Fu) << 8) | de_v_lo);
877	    uint16_t htot = (uint16_t)(((hsz_hi  & 0x1Fu) << 8) | hsz_lo);
878	    /* V_SIZE is in half-line units per the kernel driver (tc358743.c:370). */
879	    uint16_t vtot = (uint16_t)((((vsz_hi & 0x3Fu) << 8) | vsz_lo) / 2u);
880	    uint16_t fv   = (uint16_t)(((fv_hi   & 0x03u) << 8) | fv_lo);
881	    uint16_t fps  = (fv > 0u) ? (uint16_t)((10000u + fv / 2u) / fv) : 0u;
882	    uint8_t  cs   = (uint8_t)((vi3 & MASK_S_V_COLOR) >> 1);
883	    bool     il   = (vi1 & MASK_S_V_INTERLACE) != 0u;
884	    bool     lr   = (vi3 & MASK_LIMITED)       != 0u;
885	
886	    printf("TC358743: detected %ux%u%c @ %u Hz, %s %s-range; "
887	           "raster %ux%u (incl blanking); VI_STATUS1=0x%02X VI_STATUS3=0x%02X\r\n",
888	           (unsigned)w, (unsigned)h, il ? 'i' : 'p',
889	           (unsigned)fps, color_space_name(cs),
890	           lr ? "limited" : "full",
891	           (unsigned)htot, (unsigned)vtot,
892	           vi1, vi3);
893	
894	    /* Bridge CSI-TX + FIFO + HDMI-detect config snapshot — catches
895	     * bridge-side narrowing (FIFO underrun, HDMI_DET mode, CSI_ERR). */
896	    uint8_t  vi_mode = 0, hdmi_det = 0;
897	    uint16_t confctl = 0, fifoctl = 0;
898	    uint32_t csi_status = 0, csi_err = 0;
899	    (void)tc358743_rd8(VI_MODE,   &vi_mode);
900	    (void)tc358743_rd8(HDMI_DET,  &hdmi_det);
901	    (void)tc358743_rd16(CONFCTL,  &confctl);
902	    (void)tc358743_rd16(FIFOCTL,  &fifoctl);
903	    (void)tc358743_rd32(CSI_STATUS, &csi_status);
904	    (void)tc358743_rd32(CSI_ERR,    &csi_err);
905	    printf("TC358743:   CONFCTL=0x%04X FIFOCTL=0x%04X VI_MODE=0x%02X HDMI_DET=0x%02X\r\n",
906	           (unsigned)confctl, (unsigned)fifoctl,
907	           (unsigned)vi_mode, (unsigned)hdmi_det);
908	    printf("TC358743:   CSI_STATUS=0x%08lX CSI_ERR=0x%08lX\r\n",
909	           (unsigned long)csi_status, (unsigned long)csi_err);
910	
911	    /* VOUT_SET2/SET3/VI_REP governs output format including pixel-repetition
912	     * de-replication. IN_REP bits in VI_REP low nibble + IN_REP_HEN (bit 4)
913	     * could be causing horizontal halving if misconfigured. */
914	    uint8_t vout_set2 = 0, vout_set3 = 0, vi_rep = 0;
915	    (void)tc358743_rd8(VOUT_SET2, &vout_set2);
916	    (void)tc358743_rd8(VOUT_SET3, &vout_set3);
917	    (void)tc358743_rd8(VI_REP,    &vi_rep);
918	    printf("TC358743:   VOUT_SET2=0x%02X VOUT_SET3=0x%02X VI_REP=0x%02X\r\n",
919	           (unsigned)vout_set2, (unsigned)vout_set3, (unsigned)vi_rep);
920	
921	    s_detectedWidth  = w;
922	    s_detectedHeight = h;
923	
924	    if (width  != NULL) { *width  = w; }
925	    if (height != NULL) { *height = h; }
926	    return true;
927	}
928	
929	static void log_status_change(uint8_t prev, uint8_t cur)
930	{
931	    printf("TC358743: SYS_STATUS 0x%02X->0x%02X [%s%s%s%s%s%s]\r\n",
932	           prev, cur,
933	           (cur & MASK_S_DDC5V)    ? "DDC5V "  : "",
934	           (cur & MASK_S_TMDS)     ? "TMDS "   : "",
935	           (cur & MASK_S_PHY_PLL)  ? "PLL "    : "",
936	           (cur & MASK_S_PHY_SCDT) ? "SCDT "   : "",
937	           (cur & MASK_S_HDMI)     ? "HDMI "   : "",
938	           (cur & MASK_S_SYNC)     ? "SYNC"    : "");
939	
940	    bool sync_now      = (cur  & MASK_S_SYNC) != 0u;
941	    bool sync_previous = (prev & MASK_S_SYNC) != 0u;
942	    if (sync_now && !sync_previous)
943	    {
944	        (void)read_detected_format(NULL, NULL);
945	    }
946	    else if (!sync_now && sync_previous)
947	    {
948	        s_detectedWidth  = 0u;
949	        s_detectedHeight = 0u;
950	    }
951	}
952	
953	void TC358743_Tasks(void)
954	{
955	    static SYS_TIME_HANDLE pollHandle = SYS_TIME_HANDLE_INVALID;
956	    static uint8_t         lastStatus = 0u;
957	    static bool            firstPoll  = true;
958	
959	    if (i2cHandle == DRV_HANDLE_INVALID) { return; }
960	
961	    if (pollHandle != SYS_TIME_HANDLE_INVALID
962	        && !SYS_TIME_DelayIsComplete(pollHandle))
963	    {
964	        return;
965	    }
966	
967	    uint8_t sys_status;
968	    if (tc358743_rd8(SYS_STATUS, &sys_status))
969	    {
970	        s_sysStatus = sys_status;
971	
972	        if (firstPoll)
973	        {
974	            firstPoll = false;
975	            lastStatus = sys_status;
976	            printf("TC358743: watcher start; SYS_STATUS=0x%02X\r\n", sys_status);
977	            if (sys_status & MASK_S_SYNC)
978	            {
979	                (void)read_detected_format(NULL, NULL);
980	            }
981	        }
982	        else if (sys_status != lastStatus)
983	        {
984	            log_status_change(lastStatus, sys_status);
985	            lastStatus = sys_status;
986	        }
987	    }
988	
989	    pollHandle = SYS_TIME_HANDLE_INVALID;
990	    (void)SYS_TIME_DelayMS(STATUS_POLL_MS, &pollHandle);
991	}
992	
993	bool TC358743_IsLocked(void)
994	{
995	    return (s_sysStatus & MASK_S_SYNC) != 0u;
996	}
997	
998	bool TC358743_GetDetectedFormat(uint16_t *width, uint16_t *height)
999	{
1000	    if (s_detectedWidth == 0u || s_detectedHeight == 0u) { return false; }
1001	    if (width  != NULL) { *width  = s_detectedWidth;  }
1002	    if (height != NULL) { *height = s_detectedHeight; }
1003	    return true;
1004	}
1005	
1006	bool TC358743_EnableStream(bool enable)
1007	{
1008	    return tc358743_enable_stream(enable);
1009	}

52	    /* RGB888 byte-stream dump: CSI2DC VP RMS=1 emits raw bytes, ISC RLP in
53	     * BYPASS samples them, DMA PACKED8 writes one byte per clock. This is
54	     * the only config that captures all 3 bytes/pixel for RGB888 (RMS=0
55	     * collapses to 1 sample per pixel). Tradeoff: RMS=1 hits a ~25% ISC
56	     * throughput cliff on this chip. Memory: packed BGR triples. */
57	    iscObj->inputFormat           = ISC_INPUT_FORMAT_TYPE;  /* RGB */

121	bool ISC_Capture_Configure(uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
122	{
123	    if (g_running) { ISC_Capture_Stop(); }
124	
125	    if (width == 0u || height == 0u
126	        || width > ISC_CAP_MAX_W || height > ISC_CAP_MAX_H)

128	        printf("ISC_Capture: %lux%lu out of range\r\n",
129	               (unsigned long)width, (unsigned long)height);

131	    }
132	
133	    uint32_t frame_size = width * height * ISC_CAP_BPP;
134	
135	    csiObj->csiFrameWidth  = width;
136	    csiObj->csiFrameHeight = height;
137	    csiObj->csiFps         = 60u;
138	
139	    iscObj->imageWidth   = (uint16_t)width;
140	    iscObj->imageHeight  = (uint16_t)height;
141	    iscObj->outputWidth  = (uint16_t)width;
142	    iscObj->outputHeight = (uint16_t)height;
143	    iscObj->dma.address0 = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)g_framebuffer;
144	    iscObj->dma.size     = frame_size;
145	
146	    g_frame_count = 0u;
147	
148	    /* Configure order mirrors emirror's working CAMERA_Open:
149	     * CSI2DC -> CSI -> ISC. RX side must be ready before source
150	     * transmits, so the D-PHY catches the LP11->HS transition. */
151	    if (!DRV_CSI2DC_Configure(csi2dcObj))
152	    {
153	        printf("ISC_Capture: DRV_CSI2DC_Configure failed\r\n");
154	        return false;
155	    }
156	    if (!DRV_CSI_Configure(csiObj))
157	    {
158	        printf("ISC_Capture: DRV_CSI_Configure failed\r\n");
159	        return false;
160	    }
161	    if (DRV_ISC_Configure(iscObj) != 0u)
162	    {
163	        printf("ISC_Capture: DRV_ISC_Configure failed\r\n");
164	        return false;
165	    }
166	    if (DRV_ISC_Configure_DMA(iscObj) != 0u)
167	    {
168	        printf("ISC_Capture: DRV_ISC_Configure_DMA failed\r\n");
169	        return false;
170	    }
171	
172	    /* Pre-fill both buffers with a sentinel so the probe can tell which
173	     * memory regions DMA actually wrote vs. which are still untouched.
174	     * Flush cache to DDR so DMA writes land on top of known sentinel. */
175	    size_t fill_bytes = (size_t)frame_size * ISC_CAP_NUM_BUFFERS;
176	    (void)memset(g_framebuffer, 0x55, fill_bytes);
177	    SYS_CACHE_CleanDCache_by_Addr((uint32_t *)g_framebuffer, (int32_t)fill_bytes);
178	
179	    printf("ISC_Capture: configured %lux%lu ARGB32 (%lu bytes/frame); "
180	           "buffers pre-filled with 0x55\r\n",
181	           (unsigned long)width, (unsigned long)height,
182	           (unsigned long)frame_size);
183	    return true;
184	}

221	bool ISC_Capture_ProbeFrame(void)
222	{
223	    if (!g_running || iscObj == NULL) { return false; }
224	
225	    uint32_t w = iscObj->imageWidth;
226	    uint32_t h = iscObj->imageHeight;
227	    if (w == 0u || h == 0u) { return false; }
228	
229	    uint32_t frame_size = w * h * ISC_CAP_BPP;
230	
231	    /* frameIndex points at the NEXT buffer ISC will write (ISR increments
232	     * after each DDONE). Last completed buffer is the one before that. */
233	    uint32_t buf_idx = ((uint32_t)iscObj->frameIndex + ISC_CAP_NUM_BUFFERS - 1u)
234	                       % ISC_CAP_NUM_BUFFERS;
235	    uint8_t *buf = &g_framebuffer[buf_idx * frame_size];
236	
237	    SYS_CACHE_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((uint32_t *)buf, (int32_t)frame_size);
238	
239	    static const struct { const char *tag; uint32_t xf, yf; } pts[] = {
240	        {"TL", 0, 0}, {"TM", 1, 0}, {"TR", 2, 0},
241	        {"ML", 0, 1}, {"CT", 1, 1}, {"MR", 2, 1},
242	        {"BL", 0, 2}, {"BM", 1, 2}, {"BR", 2, 2},
243	    };
244	
245	    uint32_t vpisr  = CSI2DC_REGS->CSI2DC_VPISR;
246	    uint32_t gisr   = CSI2DC_REGS->CSI2DC_GISR;
247	    uint32_t fnvc0  = CSI2DC_REGS->CSI2DC_FNVC0R;
248	    uint32_t vpcolr = CSI2DC_REGS->CSI2DC_VPCOLR;
249	    uint32_t vprowr = CSI2DC_REGS->CSI2DC_VPROWR;
250	
251	    printf("ISC probe (frame=%lu, buf=%lu, %lux%lu) "
252	           "VPISR=0x%08lX GISR=0x%08lX FNVC0=0x%08lX "
253	           "VPCOL=%lu VPROW=%lu\r\n",
254	           (unsigned long)g_frame_count, (unsigned long)buf_idx,
255	           (unsigned long)w, (unsigned long)h,
256	           (unsigned long)vpisr, (unsigned long)gisr, (unsigned long)fnvc0,
257	           (unsigned long)vpcolr, (unsigned long)vprowr);
258	
259	    /* CSI2DC Image Data Snoop (IDS) — authoritative per-packet metadata
260	     * captured directly from the CSI-2 stream. Each entry holds one
261	     * {DT, VC} combination; WC is the MIPI long-packet word count (bytes)
262	     * and RC+1 is how many packets of that DT/VC the snoop has seen since
263	     * last reset. We reset IDS at end-of-probe so each probe window shows
264	     * exactly 1 second (~60 frames) of accumulated counts — divide RC by
265	     * frame delta to get per-frame row count authoritatively. */
266	    uint32_t idsisr = CSI2DC_REGS->CSI2DC_IDSISR;
267	    printf("  IDSISR=0x%08lX\r\n", (unsigned long)idsisr);
268	    for (int i = 0; i < CSI2DC_IDSEW_NUMBER; i++)
269	    {
270	        uint32_t w0 = CSI2DC_REGS->CSI2DC_IDSEW[i].CSI2DC_IDSEW0R;
271	        uint32_t w1 = CSI2DC_REGS->CSI2DC_IDSEW[i].CSI2DC_IDSEW1R;
272	        if ((w0 | w1) == 0u) { continue; }
273	        uint32_t dt = (w0 & CSI2DC_IDSEW0R_DT_Msk) >> CSI2DC_IDSEW0R_DT_Pos;
274	        uint32_t vc = (w0 & CSI2DC_IDSEW0R_VC_Msk) >> CSI2DC_IDSEW0R_VC_Pos;
275	        uint32_t wc = (w1 & CSI2DC_IDSEW1R_WC_Msk) >> CSI2DC_IDSEW1R_WC_Pos;
276	        uint32_t rc = (w1 & CSI2DC_IDSEW1R_RC_Msk) >> CSI2DC_IDSEW1R_RC_Pos;
277	        printf("  IDS[%d]: DT=0x%02lX VC=%lu WC=%lu rows=%lu\r\n",
278	               i, (unsigned long)dt, (unsigned long)vc,
279	               (unsigned long)wc, (unsigned long)(rc + 1u));
280	    }
281	    /* Reset IDS so next probe shows a fresh accumulation window. */
282	    CSI2DC_REGS->CSI2DC_IDSCR = CSI2DC_IDSCR_SWRST_1;
283	
284	    uint8_t b0min = 0xFFu, b0max = 0u;
285	    uint8_t b1min = 0xFFu, b1max = 0u;
286	    uint8_t b2min = 0xFFu, b2max = 0u;
287	    uint8_t b3min = 0xFFu, b3max = 0u;
288	
289	    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(pts) / sizeof(pts[0]); i++)
290	    {
291	        uint32_t x = (pts[i].xf == 0u) ? 0u
292	                   : (pts[i].xf == 1u) ? (w / 2u)
293	                                       : (w - 1u);
294	        uint32_t y = (pts[i].yf == 0u) ? 0u
295	                   : (pts[i].yf == 1u) ? (h / 2u)
296	                                       : (h - 1u);
297	        uint32_t off = ((y * w) + x) * ISC_CAP_BPP;
298	
299	        uint8_t b0 = buf[off + 0u];
300	        uint8_t b1 = buf[off + 1u];
301	        uint8_t b2 = buf[off + 2u];
302	        uint8_t b3 = buf[off + 3u];
303	
304	        printf("  %s (%4lu,%4lu) mem: %02X %02X %02X %02X\r\n",
305	               pts[i].tag, (unsigned long)x, (unsigned long)y, b0, b1, b2, b3);
306	
307	        if (b0 < b0min) { b0min = b0; } if (b0 > b0max) { b0max = b0; }
308	        if (b1 < b1min) { b1min = b1; } if (b1 > b1max) { b1max = b1; }
309	        if (b2 < b2min) { b2min = b2; } if (b2 > b2max) { b2max = b2; }
310	        if (b3 < b3min) { b3min = b3; } if (b3 > b3max) { b3max = b3; }
311	    }
312	
313	    printf("  9-pt range:  b0=[%02X-%02X] b1=[%02X-%02X] b2=[%02X-%02X] b3=[%02X-%02X]\r\n",
314	           b0min, b0max, b1min, b1max, b2min, b2max, b3min, b3max);
315	
316	    /* Raw hex dumps: several (row, x) offsets so we can see the actual
317	     * memory pattern without any pixel-layout assumption. 48 bytes = 16
318	     * pixels at 3 B/px, 12 pixels at 4 B/px. */
319	    struct { uint32_t y; uint32_t x; } dumps[] = {
320	        { 0u,   0u  },     /* row 0 left edge (likely black margin) */
321	        { 0u,   w/2u },    /* row 0 center (content) */
322	        { 10u,  w/2u },    /* row 10 center — iter 3 captured region */
323	        { 50u,  w/2u },    /* row 50 center — edge of iter 3 cliff */
324	        { 100u, w/2u },    /* row 100 — past iter 3 cliff, within iter 5 */
325	        { 200u, w/2u },    /* row 200 — past iter 3, within iter 5 */
326	    };
327	    for (size_t r = 0; r < sizeof(dumps) / sizeof(dumps[0]); r++)
328	    {
329	        uint32_t y = dumps[r].y;
330	        uint32_t x = dumps[r].x;
331	        if (y >= h || x >= w) { continue; }
332	        uint32_t off_start = ((y * w) + x) * ISC_CAP_BPP;
333	        printf("  r%3lu x%3lu+: ", (unsigned long)y, (unsigned long)x);
334	        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 48u; i++)
335	        {
336	            printf("%02X%s", buf[off_start + i], (i & 3u) == 3u ? " " : "");
337	        }
338	        printf("\r\n");
339	    }
340	
341	    /* Scan a known-captured row (y=30) for byte-position ranges so we can
342	     * see which byte lanes actually carry data. */
343	    uint32_t y_scan = 30u;
344	    uint8_t r0min = 0xFFu, r0max = 0u;
345	    uint8_t r1min = 0xFFu, r1max = 0u;
346	    uint8_t r2min = 0xFFu, r2max = 0u;
347	    uint8_t r3min = 0xFFu, r3max = 0u;
348	    for (uint32_t x = 0; x < w; x++)
349	    {
350	        uint32_t off = ((y_scan * w) + x) * ISC_CAP_BPP;
351	        uint8_t v0 = buf[off + 0u];
352	        uint8_t v1 = buf[off + 1u];
353	        uint8_t v2 = buf[off + 2u];
354	        uint8_t v3 = buf[off + 3u];
355	        if (v0 < r0min) { r0min = v0; } if (v0 > r0max) { r0max = v0; }
356	        if (v1 < r1min) { r1min = v1; } if (v1 > r1max) { r1max = v1; }
357	        if (v2 < r2min) { r2min = v2; } if (v2 > r2max) { r2max = v2; }
358	        if (v3 < r3min) { r3min = v3; } if (v3 > r3max) { r3max = v3; }
359	    }
360	    printf("  row=%lu rng: b0=[%02X-%02X] b1=[%02X-%02X] b2=[%02X-%02X] b3=[%02X-%02X]\r\n",
361	           (unsigned long)y_scan,
362	           r0min, r0max, r1min, r1max, r2min, r2max, r3min, r3max);

364	    /* Vertical extent of DMA writes: scan col w/2 for first non-sentinel

374	        }

377	            first_sentinel_row = y;

379	    }
380	    printf("  vertical extent: rows 0..%lu written, first sentinel at row %lu (of %lu)\r\n",

Based on my thorough search of the TC358743 Linux driver, here are the critical findings regarding your 480i interlacing issue:

### 1. **Interlaced Input Detection (Line 361-362)**
The driver detects interlaced input:
```c
bt->interlaced = i2c_rd8(sd, VI_STATUS1) & MASK_S_V_INTERLACE ?
    V4L2_DV_INTERLACED : V4L2_DV_PROGRESSIVE;
```
**Register**: `VI_STATUS1` with `MASK_S_V_INTERLACE` (0x01 from tc358743_regs.h line 410)

### 2. **CRITICAL BUG: V_SIZE Register Division by 2 (Lines 370-371)**
This is likely your issue:
```c
frame_height = (((i2c_rd8(sd, V_SIZE_HI) & 0x3f) << 8) +
    i2c_rd8(sd, V_SIZE_LO)) / 2;
```
**Problem**: The driver unconditionally **divides V_SIZE by 2** regardless of interlaced mode. This reads the total field count and halves it. For 480i:
- V_SIZE register contains the full frame height (480)
- Divided by 2 = 240
- Then for interlaced, height is multiplied by 2 later (line 385)
- Result: 240 * 2 = 480 for the timings structure, but CSI-2 output is based on the halved value

### 3. **Interlaced Height Doubling and Pixelclock Halving (Lines 384-388)**
```c
if (bt->interlaced == V4L2_DV_INTERLACED) {
    bt->height *= 2;           // 240 * 2 = 480
    bt->il_vsync = bt->vsync + 1;
    bt->pixelclock /= 2;       // For 480i, pixelclock is halved
}
```

### 4. **Pixel Repetition (VI_REP Register) - Lines 766 and 778**
The `VI_REP` register at `0x8576` is only used for color space configuration:
```c
i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, VI_REP, ~MASK_VOUT_COLOR_SEL & 0xff,
        MASK_VOUT_COLOR_601_YCBCR_LIMITED);  // Line 766
```
**From tc358743_regs.h (lines 534-545)**:
- `MASK_VOUT_COLOR_SEL` (bits 7:5) - color space selection
- `MASK_IN_REP_HEN` (bit 4) - horizontal repetition enable
- `MASK_IN_REP` (bits 3:0) - repetition factor

**Critical**: The driver never configures the horizontal repetition bits. The `IN_REP` and `VI_REP` field definitions exist in the register file but are not used in the driver code.

### 5. **MASK_INTER in CSI_CONFW - Lines 863-864**
```c
i2c_wr32(sd, CSI_CONFW, MASK_MODE_SET |
        MASK_ADDRESS_CSI_INT_ENA | MASK_INTER);
```
**From tc358743_regs.h (line 151)**:
- `MASK_INTER` (0x00000004) - This is an **interrupt enable** bit in the CSI_INT_ENA register

This bit enables CSI interlacing interrupts, not CSI output line control. The actual interlacing mode configuration is missing.

### 6. **CSI Interrupt Handler for MASK_INTER (Lines 1573-1574)**
```c
if (csi_int & MASK_INTER)
    tc358743_csi_err_int_handler(sd, handled);
```
This treats `MASK_INTER` as an error condition, confirming it's an interrupt flag.

### 7. **tc358743_s_dv_timings() Function (Lines 1648-1681)**
The function stores timings and calls:
```c
state->timings = *timings;
enable_stream(sd, false);
tc358743_set_pll(sd);
tc358743_set_csi(sd);
```

**Critical observation**: There is **no CSI output line count configuration** based on interlaced mode. The function doesn't differentiate between interlaced and progressive timings when configuring the CSI-2 output.

### 8. **No MASK_IFIELD or Interlaced Field Control**
Search confirms there is no `MASK_IFIELD` register or field selection mechanism in this driver. The driver doesn't configure which field to output or how many lines per CSI frame for interlaced content.

### 9. **Format Output Configuration (Line 1811)**
```c
format->format.field = V4L2_FIELD_NONE;
```
The driver always outputs `V4L2_FIELD_NONE` (progressive), never `V4L2_FIELD_INTERLACED` or field-specific formats.

---

## Summary of Root Cause

Your TC358743 is outputting **241 lines per CSI-2 frame (instead of 480)** because:

1. **V_SIZE is halved unconditionally** (line 370) - reads 480, stores 240 in frame_height
2. **No CSI-2 line count register is configured** for interlaced vs. progressive mode
3. **MASK_INTER is only an interrupt enable flag**, not a CSI output mode control
4. **Pixel repetition (IN_REP) is never configured** 
5. **No special interlacing mode is set in CSI_CONFW** - the driver treats interlaced and progressive identically for CSI output
6. **The driver detects interlacing but doesn't configure the CSI bridge appropriately**

The solution likely requires:
- Setting proper registers in `tc358743_set_csi()` when `state->timings.bt.interlaced == V4L2_DV_INTERLACED`
- Possibly configuring registers for field selection and line doubling in the CSI output path
- Checking Toshiba's REF_01 and REF_02 specification sheets for the CSI interlaced output configuration registers (not currently used in the driver)

- Main driver: `/Users/gregmrozek/Projects/microchip/linux-at91/drivers/media/i2c/tc358743.c`
- Register definitions: `/Users/gregmrozek/Projects/microchip/linux-at91/drivers/media/i2c/tc358743_regs.h`

## Search Results: tc358743 HDMI-to-CSI Register Analysis

I found the registers and masks you asked about in `/Users/gregmrozek/Projects/microchip/linux-at91/drivers/media/i2c/tc358743_regs.h`. Here are the exact findings:

### 1. **Interlace and Field-Related Registers**

**VI_STATUS1** (Address: 0x8522)
- `MASK_S_V_INTERLACE` (0x01) - Read-only status bit indicating if input is interlaced
- Used in driver at line 361 to detect interlaced video: reads this bit and sets output field format

No direct interlaced output control register found. The chip detects interlaced input and likely processes accordingly.

---

### 2. **VI_REP Register** (Address: 0x8576)

**Bit Functions:**
- `MASK_IN_REP` (0x0F) - Input repetition control (bits 3-0)
- `MASK_IN_REP_HEN` (0x10) - Input repetition enable (bit 4)
- `MASK_VOUT_COLOR_SEL` (0xE0) - Output color space selection (bits 7-5)

**IN_REP behavior:** When `MASK_IN_REP` bits are non-zero AND `MASK_IN_REP_HEN` is set, the hardware repeats/interpolates fields or lines for output frame rate conversion.

**Output color options controlled by MASK_VOUT_COLOR_SEL:**
- 0x00: RGB Full
- 0x20: RGB Limited
- 0x40: 601 YCbCr Full
- 0x60: 601 YCbCr Limited
- 0x80: 709 YCbCr Full
- 0xA0: 709 YCbCr Limited
- 0xC0: Full-to-Limited conversion
- 0xE0: Limited-to-Full conversion

---

### 3. **VOUT_SET2 Register** (Address: 0x8573)

**Documented Bits:**
- `MASK_SEL422` (0x80) - Select 4:2:2 output format
- `MASK_VOUT_422FIL_100` (0x40) - 4:2:2 filter (100% response)
- `MASK_VOUTCOLORMODE` (0x03) - Output color mode selection (bits 1-0)
  - 0x00: Through (passthrough)
  - 0x01: Auto
  - 0x03: Manual

**Related: VOUT_SET3** (Address: 0x8574)
- `MASK_VOUT_EXTCNT` (0x08) - Extended control (bit 3)

No additional bits affecting line count beyond the color mode and 422 filtering.

---

### 4. **CSI_CONFW Register** (Address: 0x0500)

**General Structure:**
- `MASK_MODE` (0xE0000000) - Operation mode field (bits 31-29)
  - `MASK_MODE_SET` (0xA0000000) - Set mode
  - `MASK_MODE_CLEAR` (0xC0000000) - Clear mode
- `MASK_ADDRESS` (0x1F000000) - Target register address (bits 28-24)

**MASK_INTER Bit Context:**
- **Location:** CSI_CONFW uses MASK_INTER (0x00000004) as part of CSI_INT_ENA configuration
- **Usage:** Written with `MASK_MODE_SET | MASK_ADDRESS_CSI_INT_ENA | MASK_INTER` (line 864)
- **Purpose:** This configures the CSI_INT_ENA register to enable INTER interrupt
- **In CSI_INT** (0x0414): `MASK_INTER` (0x00000004) indicates an interleaving/field interrupt event occurred

---

### 5. **CSI_INT Register** (Address: 0x0414)

**Bits:**
- `MASK_INTHLT` (0x00000008) - Halt interrupt
- `MASK_INTER` (0x00000004) - **Interleaving/Field interrupt** - Signals when interlaced field boundary is encountered

**CSI_INT_ENA** (Address: 0x0418) - Interrupt enable register with same bits

---

### 6. **VI_MODE Register** (Address: 0x8570)

**Bits:**
- `MASK_RGB_DVI` (0x08) - RGB/DVI mode selection (bit 3) - Not in official Toshiba spec

---

### 7. **Additional Vertical Control Registers**

The following registers track vertical dimensions/framing (defined but not fully masked):
- `V_SIZE_LO` / `V_SIZE_HI` (0x858C / 0x858D) - Vertical frame size
- `FV_CNT_LO` / `FV_CNT_HI` (0x85A1 / 0x85A2) - Frame/Field vertical count
- `DE_WIDTH_V_LO` / `DE_WIDTH_V_HI` (0x8588 / 0x8589) - Active vertical area

**No VOUT_FMT or MASK_HDMIDVI registers found** in this header file.

From `/Users/gregmrozek/Projects/microchip/linux-at91/drivers/media/i2c/tc358743.c`:

- MASK_INTER in CSI_CONFW enables field interrupt detection

129	/* --------------- I2C --------------- */
130	
131	static int i2c_rd(struct v4l2_subdev *sd, u16 reg, u8 *values, u32 n)
132	{
133		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
134		struct i2c_client *client = state->i2c_client;
135		int err;
136		u8 buf[2] = { reg >> 8, reg & 0xff };
137		struct i2c_msg msgs[] = {
138			{
139				.addr = client->addr,
140				.flags = 0,
141				.len = 2,
142				.buf = buf,
143			},
144			{
145				.addr = client->addr,
146				.flags = I2C_M_RD,
147				.len = n,
148				.buf = values,
149			},
150		};
151	
152		err = i2c_transfer(client->adapter, msgs, ARRAY_SIZE(msgs));
153		if (err != ARRAY_SIZE(msgs)) {
154			v4l2_err(sd, "%s: reading register 0x%x from 0x%x failed: %d\n",
155					__func__, reg, client->addr, err);
156		}
157		return err != ARRAY_SIZE(msgs);
158	}
159	
160	static void i2c_wr(struct v4l2_subdev *sd, u16 reg, u8 *values, u32 n)
161	{
162		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
163		struct i2c_client *client = state->i2c_client;
164		int err, i;
165		struct i2c_msg msg;
166		u8 data[I2C_MAX_XFER_SIZE];
167	
168		if ((2 + n) > I2C_MAX_XFER_SIZE) {
169			n = I2C_MAX_XFER_SIZE - 2;
170			v4l2_warn(sd, "i2c wr reg=%04x: len=%d is too big!\n",
171				  reg, 2 + n);
172		}
173	
174		msg.addr = client->addr;
175		msg.buf = data;
176		msg.len = 2 + n;
177		msg.flags = 0;
178	
179		data[0] = reg >> 8;
180		data[1] = reg & 0xff;
181	
182		for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
183			data[2 + i] = values[i];
184	
185		err = i2c_transfer(client->adapter, &msg, 1);
186		if (err != 1) {
187			v4l2_err(sd, "%s: writing register 0x%x from 0x%x failed: %d\n",
188					__func__, reg, client->addr, err);
189			return;
190		}
191	
192		if (debug < 3)
193			return;
194	
195		switch (n) {
196		case 1:
197			v4l2_info(sd, "I2C write 0x%04x = 0x%02x",
198					reg, data[2]);
199			break;
200		case 2:
201			v4l2_info(sd, "I2C write 0x%04x = 0x%02x%02x",
202					reg, data[3], data[2]);
203			break;
204		case 4:
205			v4l2_info(sd, "I2C write 0x%04x = 0x%02x%02x%02x%02x",
206					reg, data[5], data[4], data[3], data[2]);
207			break;
208		default:
209			v4l2_info(sd, "I2C write %d bytes from address 0x%04x\n",
210					n, reg);
211		}
212	}
213	
214	static noinline u32 i2c_rdreg_err(struct v4l2_subdev *sd, u16 reg, u32 n,
215					  int *err)
216	{
217		int error;
218		__le32 val = 0;
219	
220		error = i2c_rd(sd, reg, (u8 __force *)&val, n);
221		if (err)
222			*err = error;

225	}

314	static int get_audio_sampling_rate(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
315	{
316		static const int code_to_rate[] = {
317			44100, 0, 48000, 32000, 22050, 384000, 24000, 352800,
318			88200, 768000, 96000, 705600, 176400, 0, 192000, 0
319		};
320	
321		/* Register FS_SET is not cleared when the cable is disconnected */
322		if (no_signal(sd))
323			return 0;
324	
325		return code_to_rate[i2c_rd8(sd, FS_SET) & MASK_FS];
326	}
327	
328	/* --------------- TIMINGS --------------- */
329	
330	static inline unsigned fps(const struct v4l2_bt_timings *t)
331	{
332		if (!V4L2_DV_BT_FRAME_HEIGHT(t) || !V4L2_DV_BT_FRAME_WIDTH(t))
333			return 0;
334	
335		return DIV_ROUND_CLOSEST((unsigned)t->pixelclock,
336				V4L2_DV_BT_FRAME_HEIGHT(t) * V4L2_DV_BT_FRAME_WIDTH(t));
337	}
338	
339	static int tc358743_get_detected_timings(struct v4l2_subdev *sd,
340					     struct v4l2_dv_timings *timings)
341	{
342		struct v4l2_bt_timings *bt = &timings->bt;
343		unsigned width, height, frame_width, frame_height, frame_interval, fps;
344	
345		memset(timings, 0, sizeof(struct v4l2_dv_timings));
346	
347		/* if HPD is low, ignore any video */
348		if (!(i2c_rd8(sd, HPD_CTL) & MASK_HPD_OUT0))
349			return -ENOLINK;
350	
351		if (no_signal(sd)) {
352			v4l2_dbg(1, debug, sd, "%s: no valid signal\n", __func__);
353			return -ENOLINK;
354		}
355		if (no_sync(sd)) {
356			v4l2_dbg(1, debug, sd, "%s: no sync on signal\n", __func__);
357			return -ENOLCK;
358		}
359	
360		timings->type = V4L2_DV_BT_656_1120;
361		bt->interlaced = i2c_rd8(sd, VI_STATUS1) & MASK_S_V_INTERLACE ?
362			V4L2_DV_INTERLACED : V4L2_DV_PROGRESSIVE;
363	
364		width = ((i2c_rd8(sd, DE_WIDTH_H_HI) & 0x1f) << 8) +
365			i2c_rd8(sd, DE_WIDTH_H_LO);
366		height = ((i2c_rd8(sd, DE_WIDTH_V_HI) & 0x1f) << 8) +
367			i2c_rd8(sd, DE_WIDTH_V_LO);
368		frame_width = ((i2c_rd8(sd, H_SIZE_HI) & 0x1f) << 8) +
369			i2c_rd8(sd, H_SIZE_LO);
370		frame_height = (((i2c_rd8(sd, V_SIZE_HI) & 0x3f) << 8) +
371			i2c_rd8(sd, V_SIZE_LO)) / 2;
372		/* frame interval in milliseconds * 10
373		 * Require SYS_FREQ0 and SYS_FREQ1 are precisely set */
374		frame_interval = ((i2c_rd8(sd, FV_CNT_HI) & 0x3) << 8) +
375			i2c_rd8(sd, FV_CNT_LO);
376		fps = (frame_interval > 0) ?
377			DIV_ROUND_CLOSEST(10000, frame_interval) : 0;
378	
379		bt->width = width;
380		bt->height = height;
381		bt->vsync = frame_height - height;
382		bt->hsync = frame_width - width;
383		bt->pixelclock = frame_width * frame_height * fps;
384		if (bt->interlaced == V4L2_DV_INTERLACED) {
385			bt->height *= 2;
386			bt->il_vsync = bt->vsync + 1;
387			bt->pixelclock /= 2;
388		}
389	
390		return 0;
391	}
392	
393	/* --------------- HOTPLUG / HDCP / EDID --------------- */
394	
395	static void tc358743_delayed_work_enable_hotplug(struct work_struct *work)
396	{
397		struct delayed_work *dwork = to_delayed_work(work);
398		struct tc358743_state *state = container_of(dwork,
399				struct tc358743_state, delayed_work_enable_hotplug);
400		struct v4l2_subdev *sd = &state->sd;
401	
402		v4l2_dbg(2, debug, sd, "%s:\n", __func__);
403	
404		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, HPD_CTL, ~MASK_HPD_OUT0, MASK_HPD_OUT0);
405	}
406	
407	static void tc358743_set_hdmi_hdcp(struct v4l2_subdev *sd, bool enable)
408	{
409		v4l2_dbg(2, debug, sd, "%s: %s\n", __func__, enable ?
410					"enable" : "disable");
411	
412		if (enable) {
413			i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, HDCP_REG3, ~KEY_RD_CMD, KEY_RD_CMD);
414	
415			i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, HDCP_MODE, ~MASK_MANUAL_AUTHENTICATION, 0);
416	
417			i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, HDCP_REG1, 0xff,
418					MASK_AUTH_UNAUTH_SEL_16_FRAMES |
419					MASK_AUTH_UNAUTH_AUTO);
420	
421			i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, HDCP_REG2, ~MASK_AUTO_P3_RESET,
422					SET_AUTO_P3_RESET_FRAMES(0x0f));
423		} else {
424			i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, HDCP_MODE, ~MASK_MANUAL_AUTHENTICATION,
425					MASK_MANUAL_AUTHENTICATION);
426		}
427	}
428	
429	static void tc358743_disable_edid(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
430	{
431		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
432	
433		v4l2_dbg(2, debug, sd, "%s:\n", __func__);
434	
435		cancel_delayed_work_sync(&state->delayed_work_enable_hotplug);
436	
437		/* DDC access to EDID is also disabled when hotplug is disabled. See
438		 * register DDC_CTL */
439		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, HPD_CTL, ~MASK_HPD_OUT0, 0x0);
440	}
441	
442	static void tc358743_enable_edid(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
443	{
444		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
445	
446		if (state->edid_blocks_written == 0) {
447			v4l2_dbg(2, debug, sd, "%s: no EDID -> no hotplug\n", __func__);
448			tc358743_s_ctrl_detect_tx_5v(sd);
449			return;
450		}
451	
452		v4l2_dbg(2, debug, sd, "%s:\n", __func__);
453	
454		/* Enable hotplug after 143 ms. DDC access to EDID is also enabled when
455		 * hotplug is enabled. See register DDC_CTL */
456		schedule_delayed_work(&state->delayed_work_enable_hotplug, HZ / 7);
457	
458		tc358743_enable_interrupts(sd, true);
459		tc358743_s_ctrl_detect_tx_5v(sd);
460	}
461	
462	static void tc358743_erase_bksv(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
463	{
464		int i;
465	
466		for (i = 0; i < 5; i++)
467			i2c_wr8(sd, BKSV + i, 0);
468	}
469	
470	/* --------------- AVI infoframe --------------- */
471	
472	static ssize_t
473	tc358743_debugfs_if_read(u32 type, void *priv, struct file *filp,
474				 char __user *ubuf, size_t count, loff_t *ppos)
475	{
476		u8 buf[V4L2_DEBUGFS_IF_MAX_LEN] = {};
477		struct v4l2_subdev *sd = priv;
478		int len;
479	
480		if (!is_hdmi(sd))
481			return 0;
482	
483		switch (type) {
484		case V4L2_DEBUGFS_IF_AVI:
485			i2c_rd(sd, PK_AVI_0HEAD, buf, PK_AVI_LEN);
486			break;
487		case V4L2_DEBUGFS_IF_AUDIO:
488			i2c_rd(sd, PK_AUD_0HEAD, buf, PK_AUD_LEN);
489			break;
490		case V4L2_DEBUGFS_IF_SPD:
491			i2c_rd(sd, PK_SPD_0HEAD, buf, PK_SPD_LEN);
492			break;
493		case V4L2_DEBUGFS_IF_HDMI:
494			i2c_rd(sd, PK_VS_0HEAD, buf, PK_VS_LEN);
495			break;
496		case V4L2_DEBUGFS_IF_DRM:
497			i2c_rd(sd, PK_ACP_0HEAD, buf, PK_ACP_LEN);
498			break;
499		default:
500			return 0;
501		}
502	
503		if (!buf[2])
504			return -ENOENT;
505	
506		len = buf[2] + 4;
507		if (len > V4L2_DEBUGFS_IF_MAX_LEN)
508			len = -ENOENT;
509		if (len > 0)
510			len = simple_read_from_buffer(ubuf, count, ppos, buf, len);
511		return len < 0 ? 0 : len;
512	}
513	
514	static void print_infoframes(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
515	{
516		struct i2c_client *client = v4l2_get_subdevdata(sd);
517		struct device *dev = &client->dev;
518		union hdmi_infoframe frame;
519		u8 buffer[V4L2_DEBUGFS_IF_MAX_LEN] = {};
520	
521		/*
522		 * Updating the ACP TYPE here allows for dynamically
523		 * changing the type you want to monitor, without having
524		 * to reload the driver with a new packet_type module option value.
525		 *
526		 * Instead you can set it with the new value, then call
527		 * VIDIOC_LOG_STATUS.
528		 */
529		i2c_wr8(sd, TYP_ACP_SET, packet_type);
530	
531		if (!is_hdmi(sd)) {
532			v4l2_info(sd, "DVI-D signal - InfoFrames not supported\n");
533			return;
534		}
535	
536		i2c_rd(sd, PK_AVI_0HEAD, buffer, PK_AVI_LEN);
537		if (hdmi_infoframe_unpack(&frame, buffer, sizeof(buffer)) >= 0)
538			hdmi_infoframe_log(KERN_INFO, dev, &frame);
539	
540		i2c_rd(sd, PK_VS_0HEAD, buffer, PK_VS_LEN);
541		if (hdmi_infoframe_unpack(&frame, buffer, sizeof(buffer)) >= 0)
542			hdmi_infoframe_log(KERN_INFO, dev, &frame);
543	
544		i2c_rd(sd, PK_AUD_0HEAD, buffer, PK_AUD_LEN);
545		if (hdmi_infoframe_unpack(&frame, buffer, sizeof(buffer)) >= 0)
546			hdmi_infoframe_log(KERN_INFO, dev, &frame);
547	
548		i2c_rd(sd, PK_SPD_0HEAD, buffer, PK_SPD_LEN);
549		if (hdmi_infoframe_unpack(&frame, buffer, sizeof(buffer)) >= 0)
550			hdmi_infoframe_log(KERN_INFO, dev, &frame);
551	
552		i2c_rd(sd, PK_ACP_0HEAD, buffer, PK_ACP_LEN);
553		if (buffer[0] == packet_type) {
554			if (packet_type < 0x80)
555				v4l2_info(sd, "Packet: %*ph\n", PK_ACP_LEN, buffer);
556			else if (packet_type != 0x87)
557				v4l2_info(sd, "InfoFrame: %*ph\n", PK_ACP_LEN, buffer);
558			else if (hdmi_infoframe_unpack(&frame, buffer,
559						       sizeof(buffer)) >= 0)
560				hdmi_infoframe_log(KERN_INFO, dev, &frame);
561		}
562	
563		i2c_rd(sd, PK_MS_0HEAD, buffer, PK_MS_LEN);
564		if (buffer[2] && buffer[2] + 3 <= PK_MS_LEN)
565			v4l2_info(sd, "MPEG Source InfoFrame: %*ph\n",
566				  buffer[2] + 3, buffer);
567	
568		i2c_rd(sd, PK_ISRC1_0HEAD, buffer, PK_ISRC1_LEN);
569		if (buffer[0] == 0x05)
570			v4l2_info(sd, "ISRC1 Packet: %*ph\n",
571				  PK_ISRC1_LEN, buffer);
572	
573		i2c_rd(sd, PK_ISRC2_0HEAD, buffer, PK_ISRC2_LEN);
574		if (buffer[0] == 0x06)
575			v4l2_info(sd, "ISRC2 Packet: %*ph\n",
576				  PK_ISRC2_LEN, buffer);
577	}

616	/* --------------- INIT --------------- */
617	
618	static void tc358743_reset_phy(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
619	{
620		v4l2_dbg(1, debug, sd, "%s:\n", __func__);
621	
622		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, PHY_RST, ~MASK_RESET_CTRL, 0);
623		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, PHY_RST, ~MASK_RESET_CTRL, MASK_RESET_CTRL);
624	}
625	
626	static void tc358743_reset(struct v4l2_subdev *sd, uint16_t mask)
627	{
628		u16 sysctl = i2c_rd16(sd, SYSCTL);
629	
630		i2c_wr16(sd, SYSCTL, sysctl | mask);
631		i2c_wr16(sd, SYSCTL, sysctl & ~mask);
632	}
633	
634	static inline void tc358743_sleep_mode(struct v4l2_subdev *sd, bool enable)
635	{
636		i2c_wr16_and_or(sd, SYSCTL, ~MASK_SLEEP,
637				enable ? MASK_SLEEP : 0);
638	}
639	
640	static inline void enable_stream(struct v4l2_subdev *sd, bool enable)
641	{
642		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
643	
644		v4l2_dbg(3, debug, sd, "%s: %sable\n",
645				__func__, enable ? "en" : "dis");
646	
647		if (enable) {
648			/* It is critical for CSI receiver to see lane transition
649			 * LP11->HS. Set to non-continuous mode to enable clock lane
650			 * LP11 state. */
651			i2c_wr32(sd, TXOPTIONCNTRL, 0);
652			/* Set to continuous mode to trigger LP11->HS transition */
653			i2c_wr32(sd, TXOPTIONCNTRL, MASK_CONTCLKMODE);
654			/* Unmute video */
655			i2c_wr8(sd, VI_MUTE, MASK_AUTO_MUTE);
656		} else {
657			/* Mute video so that all data lanes go to LSP11 state.
658			 * No data is output to CSI Tx block. */
659			i2c_wr8(sd, VI_MUTE, MASK_AUTO_MUTE | MASK_VI_MUTE);
660		}
661	
662		mutex_lock(&state->confctl_mutex);
663		i2c_wr16_and_or(sd, CONFCTL, ~(MASK_VBUFEN | MASK_ABUFEN),
664				enable ? (MASK_VBUFEN | MASK_ABUFEN) : 0x0);
665		mutex_unlock(&state->confctl_mutex);
666	}
667	
668	static void tc358743_set_pll(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
669	{
670		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
671		struct tc358743_platform_data *pdata = &state->pdata;
672		u16 pllctl0 = i2c_rd16(sd, PLLCTL0);
673		u16 pllctl1 = i2c_rd16(sd, PLLCTL1);
674		u16 pllctl0_new = SET_PLL_PRD(pdata->pll_prd) |
675			SET_PLL_FBD(pdata->pll_fbd);
676		u32 hsck = (pdata->refclk_hz / pdata->pll_prd) * pdata->pll_fbd;
677	
678		v4l2_dbg(2, debug, sd, "%s:\n", __func__);
679	
680		/* Only rewrite when needed (new value or disabled), since rewriting
681		 * triggers another format change event. */
682		if ((pllctl0 != pllctl0_new) || ((pllctl1 & MASK_PLL_EN) == 0)) {
683			u16 pll_frs;
684	
685			if (hsck > 500000000)
686				pll_frs = 0x0;
687			else if (hsck > 250000000)
688				pll_frs = 0x1;
689			else if (hsck > 125000000)
690				pll_frs = 0x2;
691			else
692				pll_frs = 0x3;
693	
694			v4l2_dbg(1, debug, sd, "%s: updating PLL clock\n", __func__);
695			tc358743_sleep_mode(sd, true);
696			i2c_wr16(sd, PLLCTL0, pllctl0_new);
697			i2c_wr16_and_or(sd, PLLCTL1,
698					~(MASK_PLL_FRS | MASK_RESETB | MASK_PLL_EN),
699					(SET_PLL_FRS(pll_frs) | MASK_RESETB |
700					 MASK_PLL_EN));
701			udelay(10); /* REF_02, Sheet "Source HDMI" */
702			i2c_wr16_and_or(sd, PLLCTL1, ~MASK_CKEN, MASK_CKEN);
703			tc358743_sleep_mode(sd, false);
704		}
705	}
706	
707	static void tc358743_set_ref_clk(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
708	{
709		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
710		struct tc358743_platform_data *pdata = &state->pdata;
711		u32 sys_freq;
712		u32 lockdet_ref;
713		u32 cec_freq;
714		u16 fh_min;
715		u16 fh_max;
716	
717		BUG_ON(!(pdata->refclk_hz == 26000000 ||
718			 pdata->refclk_hz == 27000000 ||
719			 pdata->refclk_hz == 42000000));
720	
721		sys_freq = pdata->refclk_hz / 10000;
722		i2c_wr8(sd, SYS_FREQ0, sys_freq & 0x00ff);
723		i2c_wr8(sd, SYS_FREQ1, (sys_freq & 0xff00) >> 8);
724	
725		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, PHY_CTL0, ~MASK_PHY_SYSCLK_IND,
726				(pdata->refclk_hz == 42000000) ?
727				MASK_PHY_SYSCLK_IND : 0x0);
728	
729		fh_min = pdata->refclk_hz / 100000;
730		i2c_wr8(sd, FH_MIN0, fh_min & 0x00ff);
731		i2c_wr8(sd, FH_MIN1, (fh_min & 0xff00) >> 8);
732	
733		fh_max = (fh_min * 66) / 10;
734		i2c_wr8(sd, FH_MAX0, fh_max & 0x00ff);
735		i2c_wr8(sd, FH_MAX1, (fh_max & 0xff00) >> 8);
736	
737		lockdet_ref = pdata->refclk_hz / 100;
738		i2c_wr8(sd, LOCKDET_REF0, lockdet_ref & 0x0000ff);
739		i2c_wr8(sd, LOCKDET_REF1, (lockdet_ref & 0x00ff00) >> 8);
740		i2c_wr8(sd, LOCKDET_REF2, (lockdet_ref & 0x0f0000) >> 16);
741	
742		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, NCO_F0_MOD, ~MASK_NCO_F0_MOD,
743				(pdata->refclk_hz == 27000000) ?
744				MASK_NCO_F0_MOD_27MHZ : 0x0);
745	
746		/*
747		 * Trial and error suggests that the default register value
748		 * of 656 is for a 42 MHz reference clock. Use that to derive
749		 * a new value based on the actual reference clock.
750		 */
751		cec_freq = (656 * sys_freq) / 4200;
752		i2c_wr16(sd, CECHCLK, cec_freq);
753		i2c_wr16(sd, CECLCLK, cec_freq);
754	}
755	
756	static void tc358743_set_csi_color_space(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
757	{
758		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
759	
760		switch (state->mbus_fmt_code) {
761		case MEDIA_BUS_FMT_UYVY8_1X16:
762			v4l2_dbg(2, debug, sd, "%s: YCbCr 422 16-bit\n", __func__);
763			i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, VOUT_SET2,
764					~(MASK_SEL422 | MASK_VOUT_422FIL_100) & 0xff,
765					MASK_SEL422 | MASK_VOUT_422FIL_100);
766			i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, VI_REP, ~MASK_VOUT_COLOR_SEL & 0xff,
767					MASK_VOUT_COLOR_601_YCBCR_LIMITED);
768			mutex_lock(&state->confctl_mutex);
769			i2c_wr16_and_or(sd, CONFCTL, ~MASK_YCBCRFMT,
770					MASK_YCBCRFMT_422_8_BIT);
771			mutex_unlock(&state->confctl_mutex);
772			break;
773		case MEDIA_BUS_FMT_RGB888_1X24:
774			v4l2_dbg(2, debug, sd, "%s: RGB 888 24-bit\n", __func__);
775			i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, VOUT_SET2,
776					~(MASK_SEL422 | MASK_VOUT_422FIL_100) & 0xff,
777					0x00);
778			i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, VI_REP, ~MASK_VOUT_COLOR_SEL & 0xff,
779					MASK_VOUT_COLOR_RGB_FULL);
780			mutex_lock(&state->confctl_mutex);
781			i2c_wr16_and_or(sd, CONFCTL, ~MASK_YCBCRFMT, 0);
782			mutex_unlock(&state->confctl_mutex);
783			break;
784		default:
785			v4l2_dbg(2, debug, sd, "%s: Unsupported format code 0x%x\n",
786					__func__, state->mbus_fmt_code);
787		}
788	}
789	
790	static unsigned tc358743_num_csi_lanes_needed(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
791	{
792		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
793		struct v4l2_bt_timings *bt = &state->timings.bt;
794		struct tc358743_platform_data *pdata = &state->pdata;
795		u32 bits_pr_pixel =
796			(state->mbus_fmt_code == MEDIA_BUS_FMT_UYVY8_1X16) ?  16 : 24;
797		u32 bps = bt->width * bt->height * fps(bt) * bits_pr_pixel;
798		u32 bps_pr_lane = (pdata->refclk_hz / pdata->pll_prd) * pdata->pll_fbd;
799	
800		return DIV_ROUND_UP(bps, bps_pr_lane);
801	}
802	
803	static void tc358743_set_csi(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
804	{
805		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
806		struct tc358743_platform_data *pdata = &state->pdata;
807		unsigned lanes = tc358743_num_csi_lanes_needed(sd);
808	
809		v4l2_dbg(3, debug, sd, "%s:\n", __func__);
810	
811		state->csi_lanes_in_use = lanes;
812	
813		tc358743_reset(sd, MASK_CTXRST);
814	
815		if (lanes < 1)
816			i2c_wr32(sd, CLW_CNTRL, MASK_CLW_LANEDISABLE);
817		if (lanes < 1)
818			i2c_wr32(sd, D0W_CNTRL, MASK_D0W_LANEDISABLE);
819		if (lanes < 2)
820			i2c_wr32(sd, D1W_CNTRL, MASK_D1W_LANEDISABLE);
821		if (lanes < 3)
822			i2c_wr32(sd, D2W_CNTRL, MASK_D2W_LANEDISABLE);
823		if (lanes < 4)
824			i2c_wr32(sd, D3W_CNTRL, MASK_D3W_LANEDISABLE);
825	
826		i2c_wr32(sd, LINEINITCNT, pdata->lineinitcnt);
827		i2c_wr32(sd, LPTXTIMECNT, pdata->lptxtimecnt);
828		i2c_wr32(sd, TCLK_HEADERCNT, pdata->tclk_headercnt);
829		i2c_wr32(sd, TCLK_TRAILCNT, pdata->tclk_trailcnt);
830		i2c_wr32(sd, THS_HEADERCNT, pdata->ths_headercnt);
831		i2c_wr32(sd, TWAKEUP, pdata->twakeup);
832		i2c_wr32(sd, TCLK_POSTCNT, pdata->tclk_postcnt);
833		i2c_wr32(sd, THS_TRAILCNT, pdata->ths_trailcnt);
834		i2c_wr32(sd, HSTXVREGCNT, pdata->hstxvregcnt);
835	
836		i2c_wr32(sd, HSTXVREGEN,
837				((lanes > 0) ? MASK_CLM_HSTXVREGEN : 0x0) |
838				((lanes > 0) ? MASK_D0M_HSTXVREGEN : 0x0) |
839				((lanes > 1) ? MASK_D1M_HSTXVREGEN : 0x0) |
840				((lanes > 2) ? MASK_D2M_HSTXVREGEN : 0x0) |
841				((lanes > 3) ? MASK_D3M_HSTXVREGEN : 0x0));
842	
843		i2c_wr32(sd, TXOPTIONCNTRL, (state->bus.flags &
844			 V4L2_MBUS_CSI2_NONCONTINUOUS_CLOCK) ? 0 : MASK_CONTCLKMODE);
845		i2c_wr32(sd, STARTCNTRL, MASK_START);
846		i2c_wr32(sd, CSI_START, MASK_STRT);
847	
848		i2c_wr32(sd, CSI_CONFW, MASK_MODE_SET |
849				MASK_ADDRESS_CSI_CONTROL |
850				MASK_CSI_MODE |
851				MASK_TXHSMD |
852				((lanes == 4) ? MASK_NOL_4 :
853				 (lanes == 3) ? MASK_NOL_3 :
854				 (lanes == 2) ? MASK_NOL_2 : MASK_NOL_1));
855	
856		i2c_wr32(sd, CSI_CONFW, MASK_MODE_SET |
857				MASK_ADDRESS_CSI_ERR_INTENA | MASK_TXBRK | MASK_QUNK |
858				MASK_WCER | MASK_INER);
859	
860		i2c_wr32(sd, CSI_CONFW, MASK_MODE_CLEAR |
861				MASK_ADDRESS_CSI_ERR_HALT | MASK_TXBRK | MASK_QUNK);
862	
863		i2c_wr32(sd, CSI_CONFW, MASK_MODE_SET |
864				MASK_ADDRESS_CSI_INT_ENA | MASK_INTER);
865	}
866	
867	static void tc358743_set_hdmi_phy(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
868	{
869		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
870		struct tc358743_platform_data *pdata = &state->pdata;
871	
872		/* Default settings from REF_02, sheet "Source HDMI"
873		 * and custom settings as platform data */
874		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, PHY_EN, ~MASK_ENABLE_PHY, 0x0);
875		i2c_wr8(sd, PHY_CTL1, SET_PHY_AUTO_RST1_US(1600) |
876				SET_FREQ_RANGE_MODE_CYCLES(1));
877		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, PHY_CTL2, ~MASK_PHY_AUTO_RSTn,
878				(pdata->hdmi_phy_auto_reset_tmds_detected ?
879				 MASK_PHY_AUTO_RST2 : 0) |
880				(pdata->hdmi_phy_auto_reset_tmds_in_range ?
881				 MASK_PHY_AUTO_RST3 : 0) |
882				(pdata->hdmi_phy_auto_reset_tmds_valid ?
883				 MASK_PHY_AUTO_RST4 : 0));
884		i2c_wr8(sd, PHY_BIAS, 0x40);
885		i2c_wr8(sd, PHY_CSQ, SET_CSQ_CNT_LEVEL(0x0a));
886		i2c_wr8(sd, AVM_CTL, 45);
887		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, HDMI_DET, ~MASK_HDMI_DET_V,
888				pdata->hdmi_detection_delay << 4);
889		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, HV_RST, ~(MASK_H_PI_RST | MASK_V_PI_RST),
890				(pdata->hdmi_phy_auto_reset_hsync_out_of_range ?
891				 MASK_H_PI_RST : 0) |
892				(pdata->hdmi_phy_auto_reset_vsync_out_of_range ?
893				 MASK_V_PI_RST : 0));
894		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, PHY_EN, ~MASK_ENABLE_PHY, MASK_ENABLE_PHY);
895	}
896	
897	static void tc358743_set_hdmi_audio(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
898	{
899		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
900	
901		/* Default settings from REF_02, sheet "Source HDMI" */
902		i2c_wr8(sd, FORCE_MUTE, 0x00);
903		i2c_wr8(sd, AUTO_CMD0, MASK_AUTO_MUTE7 | MASK_AUTO_MUTE6 |
904				MASK_AUTO_MUTE5 | MASK_AUTO_MUTE4 |
905				MASK_AUTO_MUTE1 | MASK_AUTO_MUTE0);
906		i2c_wr8(sd, AUTO_CMD1, MASK_AUTO_MUTE9);
907		i2c_wr8(sd, AUTO_CMD2, MASK_AUTO_PLAY3 | MASK_AUTO_PLAY2);
908		i2c_wr8(sd, BUFINIT_START, SET_BUFINIT_START_MS(500));
909		i2c_wr8(sd, FS_MUTE, 0x00);
910		i2c_wr8(sd, FS_IMODE, MASK_NLPCM_SMODE | MASK_FS_SMODE);
911		i2c_wr8(sd, ACR_MODE, MASK_CTS_MODE);
912		i2c_wr8(sd, ACR_MDF0, MASK_ACR_L2MDF_1976_PPM | MASK_ACR_L1MDF_976_PPM);
913		i2c_wr8(sd, ACR_MDF1, MASK_ACR_L3MDF_3906_PPM);
914		i2c_wr8(sd, SDO_MODE1, MASK_SDO_FMT_I2S);
915		i2c_wr8(sd, DIV_MODE, SET_DIV_DLY_MS(100));
916	
917		mutex_lock(&state->confctl_mutex);
918		i2c_wr16_and_or(sd, CONFCTL, 0xffff, MASK_AUDCHNUM_2 |
919				MASK_AUDOUTSEL_I2S | MASK_AUTOINDEX);
920		mutex_unlock(&state->confctl_mutex);
921	}
922	
923	static void tc358743_set_hdmi_info_frame_mode(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
924	{
925		/* Default settings from REF_02, sheet "Source HDMI" */
926		i2c_wr8(sd, PK_INT_MODE, MASK_ISRC2_INT_MODE | MASK_ISRC_INT_MODE |
927				MASK_ACP_INT_MODE | MASK_VS_INT_MODE |
928				MASK_SPD_INT_MODE | MASK_MS_INT_MODE |
929				MASK_AUD_INT_MODE | MASK_AVI_INT_MODE);
930		i2c_wr8(sd, NO_PKT_LIMIT, 0x2c);
931		i2c_wr8(sd, NO_PKT_CLR, 0x53);
932		i2c_wr8(sd, ERR_PK_LIMIT, 0x01);
933		i2c_wr8(sd, NO_PKT_LIMIT2, 0x30);
934		i2c_wr8(sd, NO_GDB_LIMIT, 0x10);
935	}
936	
937	static void tc358743_initial_setup(struct v4l2_subdev *sd)
938	{
939		struct tc358743_state *state = to_state(sd);
940		struct tc358743_platform_data *pdata = &state->pdata;
941	
942		/*
943		 * IR is not supported by this driver.
944		 * CEC is only enabled if needed.
945		 */
946		i2c_wr16_and_or(sd, SYSCTL, ~(MASK_IRRST | MASK_CECRST),
947					     (MASK_IRRST | MASK_CECRST));
948	
949		tc358743_reset(sd, MASK_CTXRST | MASK_HDMIRST);
950	#ifdef CONFIG_VIDEO_TC358743_CEC
951		tc358743_reset(sd, MASK_CECRST);
952	#endif
953		tc358743_sleep_mode(sd, false);
954	
955		i2c_wr16(sd, FIFOCTL, pdata->fifo_level);
956	
957		tc358743_set_ref_clk(sd);
958	
959		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, DDC_CTL, ~MASK_DDC5V_MODE,
960				pdata->ddc5v_delay & MASK_DDC5V_MODE);
961		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, EDID_MODE, ~MASK_EDID_MODE, MASK_EDID_MODE_E_DDC);
962	
963		tc358743_set_hdmi_phy(sd);
964		tc358743_set_hdmi_hdcp(sd, pdata->enable_hdcp);
965		tc358743_set_hdmi_audio(sd);
966		tc358743_set_hdmi_info_frame_mode(sd);
967	
968		/* All CE and IT formats are detected as RGB full range in DVI mode */
969		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, VI_MODE, ~MASK_RGB_DVI, 0);
970	
971		i2c_wr8_and_or(sd, VOUT_SET2, ~MASK_VOUTCOLORMODE,
972				MASK_VOUTCOLORMODE_AUTO);
973		i2c_wr8(sd, VOUT_SET3, MASK_VOUT_EXTCNT);
974	}
